notes.title: Soundtrack
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
We’ve published the Original Soundtrack of the game, composed by FOKO (Emilio Martínez). The soundtrack contains 17 tracks, included the songs of the main menu and the Cutscenes. You can get this DLC for free if you already have the game. Once you get the DLC, the songs will be available on the MUSIC section of the Steam application.
